module.name: Rule Out Medical, Organic Or Drug Causes For All Disorders

instructions: If the patient codes positive for any current disorder or a major depressive episode or a manic or a hypomanic episode ask:
If O1a or O1b is coded YES, in the clinician's judgment, is either likely to be a direct cause of the patient's disorder?
If necessary, ask additional open-ended questions
O2 Summary: Has an 'organic' / medical / drug related cause been ruled out?
If O2 is YES, then O2 Summary is NO. If O2 is NO, then O2 Summary is YES. Otherwise it is uncertain

questions.prompt: Were you taking any drugs or medicines or in withdrawal from any of these?
Did you have any medical illness?
If O1a or O1b is coded YES, in the clinician's judgment, is either likely to be a direct cause of the patient's disorder? If necessary, ask additional open-ended questions.

organicCauseRuledOut.summary: If O2 is YES, then O2 Summary is NO. If O2 is NO, then O2 Summary is YES. Otherwise it is uncertain
